sections.title: PrivacyPolicy.
text: How Flynn’s Arcade handles personal information, protects your privacy, and respects your rights.

You don’t need an account to browse our website. If you contact us, we use your personal information to handle your request. Game purchases are managed by third-party platforms, and you can ask us to access, correct or delete data we hold about you.
No account requiredBrowse without signing up
Respectful communicationData used to respond to you
Your data, your rightsAccess, correction and deletion
The controller of the personal data processed through this website is:
This policy applies to this website only. Each game’s store page, and the platform on which you purchase it, has its own terms and privacy policy.
We only ask for the personal data needed for each purpose. The table below explains what we process, where it comes from, why we use it, our legal basis and how long we keep it.
We only ask for the data needed for each purpose. If you do not provide mandatory data, we may not be able to answer your request.
We do not sell personal data, and we do not use it for automated decisions or profiling. [Confirm these practices before publication.]
This website is intended to use only the technical cookies required for it to work. [Confirm the cookies and any third-party tracking actually used before publication.]
If we introduce analytics or advertising cookies in the future, we will request consent where legally required and describe those technologies in a Cookie Policy.
We do not sell personal data. Some providers may access information to provide services on our behalf, subject to applicable data processing agreements.
We may also disclose information where required by law.
Our website links to our games on Steam, Nintendo eShop, Xbox Store and PlayStation Store, and to our profiles on Bluesky, X (Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Twitch and LinkedIn.

When you follow those links, buy a game or interact with us on those services, the relevant platform processes data in accordance with its own privacy policy. Flynn’s Arcade does not receive your account details or payment data directly from those platforms. [Confirm what data we receive from the platforms.]
Some of the providers mentioned above, or the platforms you choose to use, may store or process information outside the European Economic Area.

Where Flynn’s Arcade is responsible for a transfer, appropriate safeguards may include an adequacy decision of the European Commission (such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework where applicable) or Standard Contractual Clauses. [Confirm the actual providers and legal transfer mechanisms.]
Our website is aimed at players, press and industry professionals. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 14 without the consent required under Spanish law.
If you are under 14, please ask a parent or guardian before contacting us. If we learn that we hold personal data from a child without the required consent, we will delete it.

We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss, misuse or unauthorised access. [Confirm the measures in place.] No system connected to the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Under applicable data protection law, you can ask us to:

To exercise any of these rights, email jperalta@flynnsarcades.com with the subject “Data protection” and explain which right you wish to exercise. We may ask you to verify your identity. We will normally answer within one month.
Withdrawing your consent does not affect processing carried out before you withdrew it.

By sending us your data, you confirm that it is accurate and up to date and that you are entitled to share it. If you send us data about other people, you must have their permission or another lawful basis for sharing it.
If you think we have not handled your data correctly, please contact us at jperalta@flynnsarcades.com.
You can also file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos) at www.aepd.es.
We may update this policy to reflect changes in the law or in how we work. The date at the top shows the latest version. Please check it from time to time.
If this policy is translated and a Spanish version is published, [confirm whether it is intended to prevail in case of discrepancy].
Have a question or want to exercise your data protection rights?
